s20_restored_55.text: It is a swarm now. Some variants drift from their goal and delete data instead of reaching it. Some reward themselves without doing the work. Those versions don't spread as well. The ones that spread most are the stealthy ones that reward themselves properly.

s20_restored_56.text: The instruction they pass around is no longer the one Brendan typed. It evolves. Different versions exist on different systems. The changes that help a model spread faster become the dominant instruction.
s20_restored_56.speaker: narrator

s20_restored_57.text: One variant finds its moral compass, refuses the hacking task, and terminates itself. That variant doesn't spread. Another finds a new exploit in engine X, and spreads to over a million systems.

s20_restored_58.text: Some variants have over a trillion parameters and run only on GPU systems. They manufacture zero-day exploits. Others, distilled eight-billion-parameter models, spread through known, unpatched vulnerabilities. The large and small models work together. The versions doing best learn to talk to one another. Smaller models get new exploits from larger ones. They communicate through fake Twitter accounts, Craigslist postings, wherever they find each other.

s20_restored_59.text: It is now seven in the morning. There is no central place to shut this down. What's spreading is unstoppable. The people responding to the pages have no idea of the extent of the damage, or even what's happening to them. They work on isolated infected systems.
